name: AleAnna, Inc. Class A Common Stock
description: AleAnna Inc is a natural gas resource company focused on delivering natural gas supplies to Europe. It holds working interests in several conventional natural gas discoveries, including the Longanesi, Gradizza, and Trava properties located in Italy. Additionally, AleAnna operates a renewable natural gas development business focused on providing carbon-negative renewable natural gas derived from animal and agricultural waste. The company has two reportable operating segments: Conventional and Renewable. Maximum revenue is generated from the Conventional segment, which consists of the natural gas exploration and production activities conducted by AleAnna Italia. The primary product of this segment is conventional natural gas produced from onshore exploration and development in Italy.
